scenario_title_zh: 户外+瑜伽+球衣定制沟通

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, this is Kevin from Ridge Outdoor. We are launching a 3-in-1 jacket line for FW26 and need a Chinese factory partner. Can you handle waterproof, breathable, and seam-sealed construction?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是 Ridge Outdoor 的 Kevin。我们要推 26 秋冬的三合一夹克系列，需要中国工厂伙伴。能做防水、透气和压胶缝吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 工厂能力要亮明认证：bluesign、OEKO-TEX、ISO 9001。
rounds.tips_zh: 户外大客户看 bluesign、OEKO-TEX、ISO 9001；亮认证是合作基础。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Kevin. We specialize in hardshell jackets. We can do 10K mm H2O waterproof with 15K g/m²/24h breathability, fully seam-sealed. bluesign certified.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About the 3-in-1 — outer shell is 2-layer with a detachable fleece inner. For the shell, we want a PFC-free DWR finish. Will that meet your performance target?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。关于三合一——外壳两层结构配可拆卸抓绒内胆。外壳要求无氟 DWR。能达到性能目标吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: PFC-free DWR 与含氟 DWR 性能差异；要说明持久性。
rounds.tips_zh: PFC-free DWR 喷淋 4 级是行业标准；需耐 20 次水洗仍有效。
rounds.user_response_example: PFC-free DWR is our standard. Spray grade 4 initial, retains 3-4 after 20 home washes. C6 or C0 chemistry both available.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now the yoga line — we need high-waisted leggings, 250 GSM, 4-way stretch, squat-proof, OEKO-TEX certified. Nylon-spandex ratio?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。瑜伽系列——高腰打底裤，250 GSM，四面弹，深蹲不透，OEKO-TEX 认证。锦氨比例？
rounds.common_mistakes: 锦氨比决定手感与弹性；不同比例对应不同产品。
rounds.tips_zh: 80/20 锦氨是瑜伽裤主流；88/12 压缩感强；75/25 偏便宜。
rounds.user_response_example: 80/20 nylon-spandex is our standard for yoga leggings. 75/25 is cheaper but loses recovery faster.

rounds.ai_message: 80/20 it is. About the teamwear — basketball jerseys, sublimated or tackle twill numbers?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 80/20 决定。关于球衣——号码用热升华还是贴布绣？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在热升华与贴布绣之间选
rounds.common_mistakes: sublimation 与 tackle twill 各有优劣；按设计需求选。
rounds.tips_zh: sublimation 适合全身图案；tackle twill 适合高端号码质感。
rounds.user_response_example: Sublimated for the replica jerseys, tackle twill with merrowed edge for the authentic jerseys.

rounds.ai_message: Both work for our lineup. About the tackle twill — we use poly-twill as the substrate. What's your zigzag stitch density?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 两款都适合我们产品线。关于贴布绣——我们用涤纶斜纹布为基布。你方之字缝密度多少？
rounds.common_mistakes: 贴布绣之字缝密度 5 mm 宽 2.5 mm 距是标准。
rounds.tips_zh: 贴布绣之字缝 5 mm 宽 × 2.5 mm 距是行业标准；包边缝防散口。
rounds.user_response_example: 5 mm zigzag with 2.5 mm pitch on the twill border. Merrowed edge is standard for all authentic jerseys.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now MOQ and lead time — for 5,000 pcs of the 3-in-1 jacket, 10,000 pcs of yoga leggings, and 2,000 pcs of basketball jerseys. Total 17,000 pcs across 3 categories. Lead time 90 days acceptable?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。MOQ 与交期——5,000 件三合一夹克、10,000 件瑜伽裤、2,000 件球衣，共 17,000 件跨 3 类。交期 90 天可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在交期与分批之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 跨 3 类的订单要分品类交期，不要笼统 90 天。
rounds.tips_zh: 跨 3 类订单要分品类给交期：户外 90 天、瑜伽 60 天、球衣 45 天。
rounds.user_response_example: 90 days for the jacket is fine. For yoga and basketball, 60 days is enough. Please give per-category lead time in the PI.

rounds.ai_message: Per-category lead time is OK. About pricing — 3-in-1 jacket US$45 FOB, yoga leggings US$8.50 FOB, basketball jersey US$15 FOB. Total US$410,000. TT 30/70 with 30% deposit. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 分品类交期可以。价格——三合一夹克 FOB 45 美元、瑜伽裤 FOB 8.5 美元、球衣 FOB 15 美元，合计 410,000 美元。TT 30/70，定金 30%。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 跨 3 类订单价格要分项报，不要笼统总价。
rounds.tips_zh: 跨 3 类订单要分项报单价、总价、付款条件，便于管控。
rounds.user_response_example: TT 30/70 is fine. Please send the per-category price breakdown so we can do internal costing.

rounds.ai_message: Per-category breakdown will be in the PI. Lead time 90/60/45 days per category. PP sample 15 days after PI confirmation. Ready to issue today.
rounds.ai_message_zh: PI 含分项明细。交期按品类 90/60/45 天。PP 样在 PI 确认后 15 天。今天发 PI。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与 PP 样
rounds.common_mistakes: 跨 3 类 PP 样要分品类寄出；不要混发。
rounds.tips_zh: 跨 3 类 PP 样要分品类寄出；每类 3-5 件便于核版。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. 15 days PP sample per category is fine. Deposit will be wired by Friday to start all three categories in parallel.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Kevin from Ridge Outdoor. For the FW26 line, we have 3 categories — outdoor, yoga and basketball. Before I send RFQs, can I confirm your factory can handle all three with separate production lines, not shared?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是 Ridge Outdoor Kevin。26 秋冬款 3 大类——户外、瑜伽、篮球。发 RFQ 前确认你工厂能否 3 类分线生产，不混用？
rounds.common_mistakes: 3 类合用产线易交叉污染；分线是品质前提。
rounds.tips_zh: 户外/瑜伽/球衣分线生产可避免辅料交叉污染，是品质前提。
rounds.user_response_example: We have 3 separate production lines for these 3 categories. Outdoor is dedicated, yoga and basketball share a cutting room but separate sewing lines.

rounds.ai_message: OK. About the outdoor hardshell — for 5,000 pcs, I want 3-layer Gore-Tex Pro. Is that material available with REACH compliance and bluesign certificate?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。关于户外硬壳——5,000 件，我要 3 层 Gore-Tex Pro。材料能提供 REACH 合规和 bluesign 认证吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: Gore-Tex 是品牌专供料；要走授权渠道。
rounds.tips_zh: Gore-Tex 必须走品牌授权渠道；不要走灰色进口。
rounds.user_response_example: Gore-Tex Pro is bluesign certified. REACH SVHC below 0.1%. Mill certificate will be attached with each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About the fill — the 3-in-1 inner fleece uses PrimaLoft Gold. We want 200 gsm weight. For the outer 3-in-1, we use 750-fill RDS-certified goose down. Can you source both?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。填充——三合一内胆抓绒用 PrimaLoft Gold，200 克重。外壳三合一用 750 蓬 RDS 认证鹅绒。能采购到吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: RDS 是羽绒的可持续认证；不是简单产地证明。
rounds.tips_zh: RDS 监管链覆盖从农场到成衣；要逐批提供证书。
rounds.user_response_example: Both PrimaLoft Gold and 750-fill RDS goose down are available. RDS chain of custody certificate attached with each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now the yoga leggings — our designer wants 4-way stretch ≥ 80% elongation, recovery ≥ 95%, and must pass squat-proof at 250 GSM. What's the yarn spec you recommend?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。瑜伽裤——设计师要求四面弹伸长 ≥ 80%、回弹 ≥ 95%、250 GSM 深蹲不透。你方推荐什么纱线规格？
rounds.common_mistakes: 锦纶 D 数与氨纶 D 数共同决定弹性和不透肉性。
rounds.tips_zh: 锦纶 70D/40D + 氨纶 20D 是 squat-proof 250 GSM 的成熟组合。
rounds.user_response_example: 70D/40D nylon + 20D spandex, 80/20 ratio. This combination delivers 4-way stretch ≥ 80% and recovery ≥ 95% at 250 GSM. Squat-proof is guaranteed.

rounds.ai_message: 80/20 nylon-spandex accepted. About the basketball jersey — for the authentic edition, we use tackle twill numbers with 3 layers. The middle layer is white contrast, 6 mm wide outline. What's your process for layering twill?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 80/20 锦氨接受。球衣——球员版用 3 层贴布绣号码。中间层白色撞色 6 毫米宽外圈。你方叠层工艺如何？
rounds.common_mistakes: 多层贴布绣每层要单独刀模裁切；外圈一次性包边。
rounds.tips_zh: 多层贴布绣要逐层刀模裁切，最后一次性包边锁线。
rounds.user_response_example: Each layer is die-cut separately. Layers are stacked and stitched with zigzag. Merrowed edge is done in one pass after stacking.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now about compliance — for all 3 categories, we need: REACH SVHC below 0.1%, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class II, RDS for down, and bluesign for the outdoor shell. Can you attach all four certificates per shipment?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。合规——3 类都要：REACH SVHC < 0.1%、OEKO-TEX 100 二类、羽绒 RDS、外壳 bluesign。每批能附四证吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在四证合规与成本之间权衡
rounds.common_mistakes: 四大合规证书是出口欧美的硬指标；不可省。
rounds.tips_zh: REACH + OEKO-TEX + RDS + bluesign 是欧美户外大客户标准四件套。
rounds.user_response_example: All four certificates attached with each shipment. Cost is included in our FOB price. No additional charge.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About payment — for the 3 categories, we propose 40% deposit split: 15% outdoor, 15% yoga, 10% basketball, to align with our internal budgeting. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。付款——3 类分定金比例：户外 15%、瑜伽 15%、球衣 10%，共 40%，与我方内部预算一致。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在分项定金与统一定金之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 分项定金要清晰记录每类的定金金额；不要笼统 40%。
rounds.tips_zh: 分项定金要逐类记录金额和 PO 号，便于财务对账。
rounds.user_response_example: 40% split deposit is acceptable. Please specify each category's deposit amount and PO number on the PI for our finance team.

rounds.ai_message: Per-category deposit and PO numbers will be on the PI. Three categories, three POs, three deposits. Lead time 90/60/45 days. PP sample 15 days. PI issued today. Please counter-sign within 4 days for our MD approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: PI 含分项定金与 PO 号。3 类、3 张 PO、3 次定金。交期 90/60/45 天。PP 样 15 天。今天发 PI。请 4 天内回签以便总经理审批。
rounds.common_mistakes: 3 张 PO 要分别签字回签；不要笼统回签。
rounds.tips_zh: 3 张 PO 要分别签字回签，每张独立编号便于追踪。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. 4 days MD approval for 3 POs is realistic. I will counter-sign each PO individually and arrange the split deposits by Tuesday.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Kevin from Ridge Outdoor. Before we open this 17,000-piece multi-category order, I need to flag three risks: (1) Gore-Tex Pro allocation is tight, only 3,000 m available for our Q3; (2) PrimaLoft Gold price up 12% this quarter; (3) RDS down quota in Asia is limited. We need a joint risk mitigation plan.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是 Ridge Outdoor Kevin。开这 17,000 件多品类订单前要说明三个风险：(1) Gore-Tex Pro 配额紧张，Q3 仅 3,000 米可供我方；(2) PrimaLoft Gold 本季涨 12%；(3) 亚洲 RDS 羽绒配额有限。需联合风险缓解方案。
rounds.common_mistakes: 三风险同时出现时不要简单回答；要做优先级排序。
rounds.tips_zh: 多风险要按影响排序：Gore-Tex 配额（最大）> PrimaLoft 涨价 > RDS 配额。
rounds.user_response_example: Priority: (1) Gore-Tex — substitute Pertex Shield for 2,000 pcs if Pro allocation falls short; (2) lock PrimaLoft price for Q3 today; (3) source RDS from Europe as backup.

rounds.ai_message: OK — substitute plan for Gore-Tex is critical. If we use Pertex Shield for 2,000 pcs, the waterproof rating drops from 28K to 10K mm H2O. That's still acceptable for the FW26 line, but our marketing needs to know. Do you agree?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好——Gore-Tex 替代方案是关键。如果 2,000 件用 Pertex Shield，防水等级从 28K 降至 10K mm H2O。对 26 秋冬款仍可接受，但市场部要知道。同意吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在替代方案与降级间权衡
rounds.common_mistakes: 替代材料等级降级要在 PI 中标注，避免市场部误解。
rounds.tips_zh: 材料替代导致等级降级要在 PI 与吊牌中明确标注。
rounds.user_response_example: 10K mm H2O is acceptable for the entry-tier FW26 jacket. Please split the order: 3,000 pcs Gore-Tex Pro, 2,000 pcs Pertex Shield. Label both clearly in PI.

rounds.ai_message: OK, split with clear labeling. Now PrimaLoft Gold is up 12%. We need to lock the price for the full 5,000 inner fleeces today, otherwise the FOB price won't hold. Can you confirm a price-hold for 14 days?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好，分单并清晰标注。PrimaLoft Gold 涨 12%。需今天锁定 5,000 件内胆抓绒价格，否则 FOB 不保。能 14 天锁价吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在锁价与现价之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 锁价要书面 LOI；口头不算。
rounds.tips_zh: PrimaLoft 等品牌材料涨价快；锁价要 LOI 书面确认。
rounds.user_response_example: 14-day price lock is acceptable for 5,000 pcs PrimaLoft Gold. We will issue an LOI by email today and our MD will counter-sign by tomorrow.

rounds.ai_message: LOI accepted. Now the RDS down — Asia allocation is limited, but we found European RDS with 850-fill, slightly better than the 750-fill we planned. Price up US$3 per jacket. Worth it?
rounds.ai_message_zh: LOI 接受。RDS 羽绒——亚洲配额有限，但我们找到欧洲 RDS 850 蓬，比计划的 750 蓬略好。每件夹克加 3 美元。值得吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 850 蓬 vs 750 蓬保暖提升约 13%；要权衡加价是否值得。
rounds.tips_zh: 850 蓬 vs 750 蓬保暖提升约 13%；US$3 加价在高端户外值得。
rounds.user_response_example: 850-fill RDS is worth the US$3 per jacket upgrade for our premium line. Use 850-fill for the 5,000 outer shells. Price up US$15,000 total.

rounds.ai_message: 850-fill accepted. Now the basketball jerseys — for the authentic edition with tackle twill, our tester found the merrowed edge was unraveling after 10 industrial washes. Our spec requires 30 washes. How will you fix this?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 850 蓬接受。球衣——球员版贴布绣，测试员发现 10 次工业洗后包边缝散口。规格要求 30 次。如何改进？
key_phrases: stitch density up to 6 per cm
rounds.common_mistakes: 包边缝散口通常是线密度不够或张力问题。
rounds.tips_zh: 包边缝散口要从线密度、张力、密度三方面改进。
rounds.user_response_example: We will switch to high-tenacity polyester thread, double the merrow edge, and increase stitch density to 6 per cm. This should pass 30 industrial washes.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now a question on the yoga line — our designer wants flatlock seams throughout, no overlock visible. Last year we had complaints about chafing on long runs. Will flatlock throughout solve this?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。瑜伽线——设计师要全件绷缝、不露包缝。去年长跑反馈磨皮肤。全绷缝能解决吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: flatlock 仅是线迹；接缝位置和宽幅也影响磨皮肤。
rounds.tips_zh: 全绷缝 + 无缝腰头 + 较窄接缝宽幅 = 真正防磨皮肤。
rounds.user_response_example: Flatlock throughout plus seamless waistband plus narrow 4 mm seam width will solve the chafing. We have tested this combo with our yoga partner brand successfully.

rounds.ai_message: Anti-chafe construction accepted. Now about the teamwear name & number license — for the basketball jerseys, we have an NBA license for the team logo but need separate name & number licensing for player names. Can you handle the licensing paperwork?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 防磨结构接受。球衣名号授权——球衣已有 NBA 球队 logo 授权，但球员姓名号码需要单独授权。你方能处理授权文件吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 球队 logo 与名号授权通常分开；名号授权要 NBA 单独签。
rounds.tips_zh: 球队 logo 授权 + 名号授权通常是两份独立合同；工厂只需配合执行。
rounds.user_response_example: We handle the production side only. The NBA name & number license is between your brand and the NBA. Please provide the license certificate for our compliance files.

rounds.ai_message: License certificate will be provided. Final accounting: 3 POs across 3 categories, US$425,000 total (up US$15,000 for RDS 850-fill upgrade). LOI for PrimaLoft lock, split Gore-Tex Pro / Pertex Shield, double merrow for tackle twill, flatlock + seamless waistband for yoga. PI issued today. 4-day MD approval, deposit wired Tuesday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 授权证书将提供。最终账目：3 类 3 张 PO，共 425,000 美元（RDS 850 蓬升级加 15,000 美元）。LOI 锁 PrimaLoft 价、Gore-Tex Pro 与 Pertex Shield 分单、贴布绣双包边、瑜伽全绷缝 + 无缝腰头。今天发 PI。4 天总经理审批，周二电汇定金。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 3 PO 与多风险方案
rounds.common_mistakes: 3 张 PO 要分别签字与打款；多风险方案要逐项确认。
rounds.tips_zh: 多风险订单要逐项确认：LOI、替代材料、授权、合规证书。
rounds.user_response_example: 3 POs confirmed. LOI for PrimaLoft lock signed today. Deposits wired Tuesday for each PO. We agree on the multi-risk plan. Looking forward to a smooth FW26 launch.
